title: Know your numbers: the Exposure Calculator

lines.text: Before you start, know your numbers, like checking the map before a road trip. My free Exposure Calculator is your map.
lines.on_screen: A road map with a route and a pin 'Your numbers' turns into the Exposure Calculator in a laptop frame (mtgtribe.com/jetup/tools/exposure-calculator). Title 'Know your numbers'.

lines.text: Hi, I'm MTG, Your Digital Architect.
lines.on_screen: The JetUP logo disc, MTG crown | Your Digital Architect, the title. No photo.

lines.text: Step one: tap an example. The training one is one hundred and fifty dollars of your own, plus the one hundred dollar bonus.
lines.on_screen: The real calculator page: the 'Training: $150 + $100' example button is tapped (click); the fields fill with 150, 100, 24.

lines.text: That's six thousand dollars of exposure.
Exposure is the size you trade with, not money you own.
lines.on_screen: Chip under the exposure card: 'The size you trade with, not money you own'.

lines.text: Or type your own: your money, any bonus, and the multiplier. Sonic AI's Amplify account uses twenty-four.
lines.on_screen: Each field highlights on its word (tick each): Your own money, Bonus added, Amplify multiplier 24x.

lines.text: Now drag the price move. One percent on six thousand is sixty dollars, in either direction.
lines.on_screen: The slider is dragged to +1% then to -1%: 'Profit or loss from this move' shows $60 then -$60, the same size both ways.

lines.text: Bigger exposure means bigger swings, up and down.
lines.on_screen: The move meter fills calmly; label: same size, both directions.

lines.text: The last two results are your lines to know. With the training example, a two and a half percent move equals your own one hundred and fifty, and about four point two percent equals the whole balance.
lines.on_screen: The two last result cards spotlit: 'Move that equals your deposit 2.5%' and 'Move that equals the whole balance 4.17%'.

lines.text: And the loss limit is written down before you start: ten percent of the starting balance, or five percent with a community token.
lines.on_screen: The page's own info note about TAG Markets' loss limit spotlit (10%, 5% with a community token).

lines.text: So that's the calculator: tap an example or type your own, read your exposure, drag a move, and know your lines before you start.
lines.on_screen: Four ticks: Tap an example or type your own, Read your exposure, Drag a move, Know your lines.

lines.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.
lines.on_screen: The lime 'Open the Exposure Calculator' and 'Join JetUP' buttons with the mtgtribe.com/jetup pill.

lines.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.
lines.on_screen: The Join JetUP button is tapped on its words.

lines.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.
lines.on_screen: The fixed signature ending, links off, Next: the 70/30 split.
